---
title: "Map 21st century eclipses"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(readr)
library(ggiraph)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
eclipse_data <- read_csv("data/formatted_eclipses.csv")
```

```{r}
eclipse_data <- eclipse_data %>%
  mutate(
    hover = paste(
      "Type:",
      Type,
      "<br>Date:",
      Date,
      "<br>Time:",
      `Time ofgreatest eclipse(Terrestrial Time)`
    )
  )

eclipse_colors <- c(
  "Total" = "#000000",
  "Total (non-central)" = "#000000",
  "Annular" = "#051427",
  "Annular (non-central)" = "#051427",
  "Partial" = "#a44322",
  "Hybrid" = "#530f1e"
)

plot_ly(
  eclipse_data,
  type = "scattermapbox",
  lat = ~Latitude,
  lon = ~Longitude,
  color = ~Type,
  colors = eclipse_colors,
  text = ~hover,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  marker = list(size = 7, opacity = 0.65)
) |>
  layout(
    mapbox = list(
      style = "open-street-map",
      center = list(
        lon = 0,
        lat = 0
      ),
      zoom = 0.01
    )
  )
```
